commentary: The headline index bounce to 23,146 (+0.65%) driven by IT earnings is deceptive. With an internal breadth score of just 31, the deterministic gate remains WEAK. Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil teach that market direction governs individual stock success: during weak breadth phases and heavy institutional distribution, up to three out of four breakouts fail. Even as select individual candidates trigger technical setups, Minervini's progressive exposure rule requires keeping position sizes small, raising cash, and demanding strict confirmation. Only true Stage 2 leaders with genuine, accelerating earnings (C+A) merit watchlist priority until market internals decisively confirm an institutional accumulation phase.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

21STCENMGM.technical: Attempting a double bottom breakout through 46.54 on 3.89x volume, clearing EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 70. However, overhead structural supply from multi-year decay poses severe resistance.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Highly erratic investment holding operation characterized by recurring operational and net losses (-₹12.9 Cr in March 2026), deeply negative ROCE (-57%), and zero institutional backing, failing CANSLIM requirements.
21STCENMGM.risk: A breakdown below the 42.82 pivot stop (-8.0%) invalidates the bottoming structure, risking immediate illiquid markdown.

63MOONS.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of the 958.91 pivot on 1.99x volume expansion, maintaining price above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 61 shows steady, unexhausted momentum.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite a revenue surge to ₹137 Cr from a depressed base, the business remains unprofitable (-₹47.6 Cr net loss in Q1 FY27). Negative ROCE (-3.7%) offsets conservative debt levels (D/E 0.15).
63MOONS.risk: Close below the 872.77 stop (-9.0%) violates the base support and 50-day average, signaling consolidation breakdown.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Forming an ascending base with two aligned swing lows below the 110.11 neckline. RSI at 66 indicates constructive pressure, though volume confirmation at the pivot remains incomplete.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Sharp top-line contraction (-56% YoY) and falling net profit (-26% YoY to ₹1.02 Cr) highlight operational headwinds. Subdued ROCE (5.6%) and a 7.2% promoter stake reduction over three years deter CANSLIM interest.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A breach below 100.50 (-8.7%) breaches critical swing lows and moving averages, terminating the recovery pattern.

AARTIIND.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing a 20-session high at 552.30 on 1.41x volume. Upward-sloping EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 confirm a newly established Stage 2 uptrend with RSI at 56.
AARTIIND.fundamental: Impressive operational turnaround with PAT leaping 260% YoY to ₹155 Cr and revenue up 41%, aided by specialty chemical volume recovery and 14.7% EBITDA margins. Net debt/EBITDA (3.6x) remains the primary monitorable.
AARTIIND.risk: A close below 514.53 (-6.8%) violates the breakout pivot and 21 EMA, requiring strict capital preservation.

ANGELONE.technical: Decisive breakout above prior 20-session highs at 323.32 on heavy 2.49x volume, aligned well above ascending EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 63 reflects solid accumulation.
ANGELONE.fundamental: Robust fintech franchise with Q2 PAT up 58% YoY to ₹335 Cr on ₹1,427 Cr revenue, powered by 48.9% standalone operating margins and record client funding books, though growth decelerated from Q1 (+102%).
ANGELONE.risk: A drop below 303.40 (-6.2%) violates the pivot base and short-term moving average, requiring an immediate stop-out.

AONELIQUID.technical: Overnight cash-equivalent ETF tracking the Nifty 1D Rate Index. Displays a monotonic creeping NAV rather than an equity momentum structure; breakout signals reflect cash-management artifacts.
AONELIQUID.fundamental: Angel One Nifty 1D Rate Liquid ETF is a debt mutual fund vehicle investing in overnight Tri-Party Repos. Corporate CANSLIM metrics (EPS, revenue, ROE, margins, leverage) are fundamentally inapplicable.
AONELIQUID.risk: Any break below 1084.67 represents an execution anomaly or pricing error; exit cash management instruments at par.
